KXNFLANYTD.rules_primary: If Zay Jones scores a touchdown in Dallas at Arizona professional football game originally scheduled for Nov 3, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNFLANYTD.rules_secondary: The following market refers to a player or team in Dallas at Arizona professional football game originally scheduled for Nov 3, 2025. If a player is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the last fair market price before game start. Once a player takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown Scorer market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No.
